keyPoints: Vidhyut dhara (current): charge ka pravah — ampere (A) me naapi jaati hai.
Vibhavantar (voltage): dhara ko dhakelne wala bal — volt (V) me naapa jaata hai.
Pratirodh (resistance): dhara ke raaste ki rukavat — ohm (Ω) me.
Ohm ka niyam: V = I x R (voltage = current x resistance).
Shreni kram (series) me dhara same rehti hai, vibhavantar bat jaata hai.
Samantar kram (parallel) me vibhavantar same rehta hai, dhara bat jaati hai — ghar ki wiring isi me hoti hai.
Vidhyut shakti (power) P = V x I — watt me; bijli ka bill unit (kWh) me aata hai.
Fuse ka taar zyada dhara par pighal kar circuit tod deta hai — ye suraksha ke liye hota hai.
